observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Blue Gate UPS.
The brand 'BLUE GATE' and model 'BG1530 Elite Pro' are clearly printed on the box.
The box indicates it is a 'Line Interactive UPS'.
The actual UPS device is not visible in the photo; only the packaging is shown.
The box is resting on a grey, possibly concrete, floor.

claims.claim: A UPS is a device that provides backup power to electronic devices when the main power source fails.
claims.evidence: This is the standard definition of the product type shown on the box.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS unit outside of the box.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid batteries may be dead or have significantly reduced capacity.
risks.proof: A video of the UPS powering a known load (like a desktop PC or lamp) while unplugged from the wall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring immediate battery replacement.

risks.risk: The unit may have internal circuit faults or blown fuses.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit successfully completing a self-test upon power-up.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit outside of the box.
Photo of the label/sticker on the back of the actual unit to confirm the model and serial number.
Video of the unit powered on and supporting a load while disconnected from the mains power.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. Without photos of the actual device, its existence and physical condition cannot be verified.
